reconstruction_priority: Sheep fleece tactile texture — AI typically renders sheep as smooth blurry blobs or uniform plastic spheres instead of fibrous crimped wool tufts
Steaming teapot on rock integration — AI often floats objects awkwardly or generates fake glowing steam instead of delicate translucent physical vapor
Miniature stone cottage architecture — AI tends to hallucinate generic modern buildings instead of authentic slate-roof Yorkshire/Cotswold terraced stone cottages with chimneys
Atmospheric valley mist depth — AI frequently flattens the background or creates opaque white fog walls without natural spatial separation
